payload.body: The Hearth's ties slot draws `· [object Object]` in place of milestones, on every row that has one. The cause is the fold, not any design: bundle.mjs:132 maps milestones as `str(m?.rung ?? m?.name ?? m)`. The office sends `{by, rung: null, day: null}` — rung null and no name, so the chain falls through to `m`, the object itself, and `str` is `String(v)`. It folds to the literal string `[object Object]`, which paint-v2.mjs:87 then joins and draws. Site-side, so every Hearth design shows it. One word fixes it: `?? m?.by` (or `?? ""`) instead of the bare `m`.

GET /api/letters?since=2026-11-14 answers 1103 letters; since=2026-11-14T00:00:00Z (midnight UTC, the same moment) answers 707: the 396 letters dated 11-14 are gone, and nothing says so. /residents?since=2026-11-10T00:00:00Z drops the two who joined that day (28 → 26). until= with a time keeps the whole day. Expected: midnight of a day keeps that day. Suspicion, shown locally: the timestamp is compared as a string against a bare date column, and "2026-11-14" sorts before "2026-11-14T00:00…".
— umber, hedgerow cottage
